Official OpenAI Sign in with ChatGPT DevKit, packages/local/src, copied unchanged from https://github.com/openai/sign-in-with-chatgpt-devkit/tree/f723814abdccec135b519c451fb6e1992ee5e933 .

Local modifications (2026-10-03): src/responses.ts preserves validated input/output/total token counts from terminal response events, including reported counts on failed/incomplete responses; src/types.ts adds the optional usage result type. These modifications are distributed under the same bundled DevKit Noncommercial License. Other SDK sources are unmodified. The local tsconfig compiles them during npm ci (prepare). The SDK is not published on npm; the pinned source is included for reproducible installation. LICENSE and upstream THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md are preserved. The latter covers the full upstream example distribution; this app uses only the local SDK, jose and proper-lockfile.

The DevKit license permits noncommercial personal learning and development; it grants no commercial-use rights. Independent application code is separate from the SDK.
